description: BigVRSP generates benchmark instances for long-haul vehicle routing and truck scheduling. Its contributors publish Python scripts for freight operations such as tanker-fuel and bulk-grain transport, using user-provided historical records or artificial inputs. Users configure locations, truck types, fleet positions and customer requests. The generator creates trucks.csv and jobs.csv with coordinates, capacities, delivery windows and optional operating attributes. Geography is selected through input locations or country-based generation; time windows follow the constructed scenario, not a fixed observation period. GitLab publishes the source and command-line instructions, requiring Python 3.10 or later and supporting packages. The current README states GPL version 3, allowing free code reuse. The linked Zenodo archive instead reports CC-BY-4.0, a discrepancy retained, not silently resolved. Generated instances support method testing and do not constitute observed freight demand. The tool is oriented to inter-city, not local delivery problems. Related record model-sumo is a transport simulator, with no verified direct importer. No instance generation or optimisation was executed.
name: BigVRSP
